files.name: Voice test A — Puck / Bella
files.note: Cat am_puck 110 Hz — bright, energetic, cheekiest of the three. Mouse af_bella 197 Hz. Widest pitch gap at 87 Hz, easiest for a 3-6 year old to follow who is talking.

files.name: The Cat and the Clever Mouse — Episode 1
files.note: First full episode. Narrated by af_heart (approved), so no lip sync needed. 5 shots, 4 hard cuts, iris out. Original rigs, background, MIDI score and SFX all generated locally. Free/offline throughout.

files.name: Pip and the Snail — v4 (HyperFrames + Rhubarb)
files.note: Five shots, three hard cuts, close-up on the face. Articulated 8-part fox rig with knee joints, lids, brows and a hinged jaw driven by Rhubarb. Snail voiced separately.

files.name: Narration C — Onyx (low male)
files.note: Same narration, lower and slower. Most 'storybook at bedtime' of the three.

files.name: Narration B — Heart (warm female)
files.note: Same narration, warmer female storyteller. Fastest read of the three.

files.name: Narration A — George (warm British male)
files.note: Storyteller version. 'A cat chased a little mouse along the sunny footpath. The mouse was quick. The cat was sure he would catch him. But the mouse was faster than he looked.'

files.name: Episode 1 — subtitles
files.note: Timed to the measured narration spans.
